system.effect:
Effect: You may craft one of the @CompSearch[items keywords=Weather Clay]{Weather Clays}, for $1000, or one of the following combos of Shards:
- Parched Clay: 2 Red, 2 Green
- Moist Clay: 3 Blue, 1 Yellow
- Frigid Clay: 2 Blue, 2 Orange
- Rough Clay: 3 Yellow, 1 Orange
- Powdery Clay: 2 Green, 2 Red
- Porous Clay: 4 Blue
- Chalky Clay: 2 Violet, 2 Red
- Acidic Clay: 4 Violet
- Pitch Clay: any 6 Shards
- Iridescent Clay: any 5 Shards

Bonus: You are immune to negative effects of Weathers created by you or your allies.
system.name: Climatology [CR]
